How many days left?

About Qatar National Day

Qatar National Day marks Sheikh Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani's succession on 18 December 1878.

Frequently asked questions

When is Qatar National Day 2026?

Friday 18 December 2026.

Is National Day a private-sector holiday in Qatar?

Yes, 18 December is a fully paid official holiday under the Labour Law; working on it earns extra pay.
